CustomField.description: The number of seconds to wait between retry attempts under the default linear backoff. 0 means no automatic retry, except while the circuit breaker is open: then the retry waits for its cool-off. Works with Max Retry Count to control retry timing. The wait worked out from this value is never longer than 300 seconds, so a value above 300 has the same effect as 300, unless the handler class overrides createRetryStrategy() and sets its own maximum.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Seconds to wait between retry attempts (30 = a 30-second wait). 0 means no automatic retry, except while the circuit breaker is open. The wait from this value never goes above 300 seconds unless the handler class overrides createRetryStrategy().
CustomField.label: Retry Backoff (sec)
